strategy_path.description: Path to the written Observability_Strategy.md file.

audit_log_events.description: Named audit_log events for every human-initiated action in the system.

trigger.description: What human action triggers this event.

sync_log_events.description: Named sync_log events for every cron job and background process.

health_endpoint_defined.description: Whether /api/health GET endpoint is specified in the strategy.

pii_masking_defined.description: Whether PII masking rules are explicitly defined for each PII field type.

alerting_thresholds_defined.description: Whether alerting thresholds are defined for all components.

log_schema_complete.description: Whether the base log schema defines all 7 mandatory fields: timestamp, level, service, traceId, userId, event, payload.

compliance_gaps.description: Any gaps detected against context_view.md §9 requirements. Must be empty to pass quality gate.
